percentage.diff.title: Percentage difference between two numbers
percentage.diff.q: What is the % difference between {a} and {b}?
percentage.seo.how1: All the common percentage problems in one place: X% of a number, what percent one number is of another, percentage increase or decrease, finding the original number, adding tax, price after discount, original price before discount and percentage difference.
percentage.seo.how2: Each problem has a clear question; enter the numbers and the result appears instantly with the formula.
percentage.seo.how3: Useful for discounts, profit and loss, grades and revenue growth.
percentage.faq.q1: How do I calculate percentage change?
percentage.faq.q2: Does a 20% cut then a 20% rise return to the old price?
percentage.faq.a2: No, you end at 96% of the original because the rise applies to the reduced price.
percentage.faq.q3: How do I find the original price from the sale price?
percentage.faq.a3: Original price = sale price ÷ (1 − discount rate).
percentage.faq.q4: How do I add 10% sales tax?
percentage.faq.a4: Multiply the price by 1.1; use the add-a-percentage section.
percentage.faq.q5: How is percentage difference different from percentage change?
percentage.faq.a5: Difference divides by the average of the two numbers and does not care which comes first.

unit-convert.seo.how1: Quickly convert 13 groups of units: length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, time, data, pressure, energy, power, fuel economy and angle.
unit-convert.seo.how2: Enter one value and the tool converts it to every unit in the group, including imperial and US units such as inches, feet, miles, pounds and gallons.
unit-convert.faq.q2: How do I convert Celsius to Fahrenheit?
unit-convert.faq.a3: An SI kilobyte is 1000 bytes; a KiB is 1024 bytes. Both are included.
unit-convert.faq.q5: Can I convert L/100 km to mpg?
unit-convert.faq.a5: Yes, in the fuel economy group.

age-calc.note: Age is counted the usual way: one full year once your birthday has passed. People born on Feb 29 celebrate on Feb 28 in non-leap years.
age-calc.pick: Pick your date of birth to see results.
age-calc.future: The birth date is after the age date. Please check the year of birth.
age-calc.animalNote: (by calendar year; if born before Lunar New Year, you belong to the previous year's animal)
age-calc.seo.how1: Enter your date of birth to see exactly how many years, months and days old you are and how long until your next birthday.
age-calc.seo.how2: The tool also shows your zodiac sign, Chinese zodiac animal and the total months, weeks and days you have lived. You can calculate age on any date, for example the day you submit an application.
age-calc.seo.how3: Results use the Gregorian calendar and handle leap years.
age-calc.faq.a1: As completed years, increasing only after each birthday.
age-calc.faq.q2: Born on 29 February, when is my birthday in other years?
age-calc.faq.a2: In non-leap years the birthday is counted on 28 February.
age-calc.faq.q3: Can I calculate East Asian age?
age-calc.faq.a3: The tool uses the Gregorian calendar; traditional East Asian age is usually 1 to 2 years higher.
age-calc.faq.q4: Can I calculate age on another date?
age-calc.faq.a4: Yes, change the date to calculate age on instead of today.
age-calc.faq.a5: No, it is only used for the calculation on your device.

date-calc.biz: Count business days only (skip Saturdays and Sundays) for the days part
date-calc.swapped: dates swapped into the right order
date-calc.seo.how1: Count the days between two dates, for example how many days are left until an exam, or add and subtract days, weeks, months and years to find a deadline.
date-calc.seo.how2: The result also shows the equivalent weeks and months and the weekday of the resulting date.
date-calc.seo.how3: When adding months to the end of a month, such as 31 January plus 1 month, the result moves to the last day of the next month.
date-calc.faq.a1: By default the start date is not counted; turn on the option to count both ends.
date-calc.faq.a2: 28 February, or 29 in a leap year, because February has no 31st.
date-calc.faq.q3: I want to skip Saturdays and Sundays?
date-calc.faq.a4: Yes, within the browser's calendar range.
date-calc.faq.q5: Does it calculate hours and minutes?
date-calc.faq.a5: Use the Time Calculator to add and subtract hours and minutes.

gpa.sLetter: Letter grades A, B, C, D, F (4.0 scale)
gpa.needImpossible: This semester alone can't reach your target, even with top grades; you'll need more semesters.
gpa.needTpl: To reach your target cumulative GPA, this semester's GPA needs to be at least
gpa.targetHint: Enter your cumulative GPA and credits to see the new GPA and the grade you need.
gpa.convNote: Schools may convert grades slightly differently; check your school's policy.
gpa.seo.how1: GPA is a credit-weighted average: courses with more credits count more. The formula is the sum of (grade × credits) divided by total credits.
gpa.seo.how2: Enter each course with its grade and credits and choose the 10-point or 4-point scale. The tool converts letter grades A, B, C, D, F and calculates a cumulative GPA across semesters.
gpa.seo.how3: Conversion tables differ between universities, so check your school's rules.
gpa.faq.q1: How do I convert a 10-point grade to the 4-point scale?
gpa.faq.a1: Usually through letter grades: 8.5 and above is A (4.0), 7.0 to 8.4 is B (3.0), 5.5 to 6.9 is C (2.0), 4.0 to 5.4 is D (1.0).
gpa.faq.q2: What GPA counts as very good?
gpa.faq.a2: Many universities rate a 4-point GPA of 3.2 or more as very good and 3.6 or more as excellent.
gpa.faq.a3: No. Courses such as physical education usually do not count towards GPA.
gpa.faq.q4: Can I calculate a cumulative GPA?
gpa.faq.a4: Yes, add several semesters to get the cumulative result.
gpa.faq.q5: Will the result match my school exactly?
gpa.faq.a5: If your school rounds differently, the result may differ slightly.

due-date.disclaimer: For reference only. Only about 4% of babies arrive exactly on their due date; most are born between 37 and 42 weeks. Always follow up with your doctor or midwife.
due-date.lLmp: First day of your last period
due-date.seo.howTitle: How a due date is calculated
due-date.seo.how1: The due date is usually the first day of your last period plus 280 days (Naegele's rule), adjusted for your cycle length.
due-date.seo.how2: You can also calculate from the conception date or an ultrasound result. The tool shows the current pregnancy week, the trimester and key check-up milestones.
due-date.seo.how3: Only about 5% of babies arrive on their due date; most are born within 2 weeks before or after.
due-date.faq.a1: From the first day of the last period, about 2 weeks before conception.
due-date.faq.q2: Ultrasound and last period disagree, which do I follow?
due-date.faq.a2: Doctors usually go by the first-trimester ultrasound if the difference is large.
due-date.faq.a3: Enter your cycle length and the tool adds the difference from 28 days.
due-date.faq.q4: What are the key check-up milestones?
due-date.faq.a4: Such as the nuchal translucency scan at weeks 11 to 14, the anatomy scan at weeks 18 to 22 and the glucose test at weeks 24 to 28.
due-date.faq.a5: No. Follow the schedule from your obstetrician.

spin-wheel.removeWinner: Remove the winner from the wheel automatically
spin-wheel.fair: The result is picked with your browser's secure random number generator (crypto), so every entry has an equal chance. To give an entry double the chance, enter it twice.
spin-wheel.sample:
Emma
Liam
Olivia
Noah
Ava
James
Sophia
Lucas
spin-wheel.needTwo: Add at least 2 entries to spin.
spin-wheel.seo.how1: A spin wheel picks at random fairly: prize draws, choosing a student to answer, deciding what to eat for lunch or assigning tasks in a team.
spin-wheel.seo.how2: Enter a list of names or prizes, one per line, and spin. You can remove winners automatically to keep spinning and open full screen for presenting.
spin-wheel.seo.how3: Results use the browser's random number generator, so every entry has the same chance. Your list is saved for next time.
spin-wheel.faq.a1: Yes, every entry has the same probability and nobody can influence the result.
spin-wheel.faq.a2: Yes, turn on remove winner so nobody wins twice.
spin-wheel.faq.q3: How many entries can I add?
spin-wheel.faq.a3: There is no hard limit; with many entries the text on the wheel gets small.
spin-wheel.faq.q4: Can I use it on a projector?
spin-wheel.faq.a4: Yes, click full screen to show a large wheel.
spin-wheel.faq.a5: Yes, free with no account needed.

random-number.sortOpt: Sort results from smallest to largest
random-number.fair: Uses your browser's secure random number generator (crypto.getRandomValues), with no bias toward any number.
random-number.errRange: Enter both the smallest and the largest number.
random-number.errEmpty: No numbers are left in the range after exclusions.
random-number.errUnique2: different numbers; lower the count or untick "No duplicates".
random-number.more: more numbers (press Copy to get them all)
random-number.seo.howTitle: Random number generator and lucky draw
random-number.seo.how1: Generate one or many random numbers in any range, such as 1 to 100, for prize draws, assigning numbers or picking a lucky winner.
random-number.seo.how2: Turn on no duplicates so each number appears only once, exclude numbers you do not want and sort the result if needed. Quick presets include dice, a 6/45 lotto ticket and two-digit numbers.
random-number.seo.how3: Numbers are generated with the browser's secure random number generator.
random-number.faq.q1: Can I draw many numbers without repeats?
random-number.faq.a2: Yes, they use the browser's cryptographic random generator.
random-number.faq.a3: Yes, enter a range that includes negative numbers.
random-number.faq.q4: Can I use it for a real lottery?
random-number.faq.a4: It is for fun only and does not improve your chances.
random-number.faq.a5: Yes, previous draws are listed below the result.

typing-test.texts: Every morning I get up early and go for a run around the lake. The fresh air clears my head and gets me ready for a new day at work. After that I have breakfast with my family, read a few pages of a book and then start my day. Small habits repeated every day add up to big changes over time.|The United States has an enormous variety of landscapes, from the sunny beaches of California to the snowy peaks of the Rocky Mountains. Travelers can explore the canyons of Arizona, enjoy the music of New Orleans or walk through the busy streets of New York City. Every region has its own character.|Learning to touch type is a useful skill for anyone who works with a computer. Once you get used to it, you no longer need to look at the keyboard, your typing speed rises and you make fewer mistakes. Practice for about fifteen minutes each day, focus on accuracy first and then slowly build up your speed.
typing-test.typeHere: Type here (the timer starts with your first keystroke)
typing-test.howTo: WPM = correct words per minute (every 5 correctly typed characters count as 1 word). Benchmarks: 40 WPM is good, 60 WPM is fast, over 80 WPM is very fast.
typing-test.seo.how1: Measure typing speed in WPM (words per minute, where every 5 correct characters count as 1 word) and accuracy. The timer starts when you type the first character.
typing-test.seo.how2: Choose the test length and type the sample text; the result shows speed, raw speed, errors, a skill rating and your personal best.
typing-test.seo.how3: Practising a few minutes a day with all ten fingers improves speed noticeably.
typing-test.faq.a1: The average is about 40 WPM; over 60 is fast and over 80 is very fast.
typing-test.faq.a2: Correct characters divided by 5, divided by the minutes.
typing-test.faq.a4: Yes, recent attempts and your best are saved in the browser.
typing-test.faq.a5: Use all ten fingers, do not look at the keyboard, and focus on accuracy before speed.

cps-test.info: CPS (clicks per second) is how many times you click each second. Most people reach about 6–7 CPS; gamers who practice jitter or butterfly clicking can hit 10–14 CPS. Your records are saved only on your device.
cps-test.restartIn: click again after 1 second to play again
cps-test.seo.how1: CPS (clicks per second) is how many times you click each second, often used by gamers to measure hand speed. Click as fast as you can during the chosen time and the tool calculates your average CPS.
cps-test.seo.how2: Choose the duration and mode: mouse/tap or the space bar. Your best score and recent attempts are saved.
cps-test.seo.how3: It works on computers and touch-screen phones.
cps-test.faq.a1: Most people reach about 6–7 CPS; practised gamers reach 10–14.
cps-test.faq.a2: Such as jitter clicking and butterfly clicking; keep your hand relaxed to avoid strain.
cps-test.faq.q3: Can I test the space bar?
cps-test.faq.q5: Does it work on a phone?
cps-test.faq.a5: Yes, tap the click area repeatedly.

webcam-test.privacy: The video is shown only on your device; nothing is recorded or sent anywhere. Test photos stay on this page until you download them.
webcam-test.noApi: This browser doesn't support the camera, or the page isn't served over https. Please use a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
webcam-test.errDenied: Camera access is blocked. Click the lock icon next to the page address, allow Camera, then press Turn on camera again.
webcam-test.errNotFound: No suitable camera found. Make sure it's plugged in and not switched off by a hotkey, or choose Automatic resolution.
webcam-test.errBusy: The camera is being used by another app (Zoom, Teams, Skype…). Close that app and try again.
webcam-test.errOther: Couldn't start the camera. Try again or restart your browser.
webcam-test.name: Camera name
webcam-test.seo.how1: Before an online meeting or interview, check that your camera shows a picture with enough light and that your microphone picks up sound.
webcam-test.seo.how2: Choose the camera and the resolution to try, mirror the image, take a test photo and view it full screen. The tool gives specific messages when the camera is blocked, missing or in use by another app.
webcam-test.seo.how3: The picture is shown only on your device; it is not recorded or sent anywhere.
webcam-test.faq.q1: My camera shows nothing, what should I do?
webcam-test.faq.a1: Check camera permission under the lock icon next to the address bar and close Zoom, Teams or other apps using the camera.
webcam-test.faq.q2: How do I know my camera's real resolution?
webcam-test.faq.a2: Choose a resolution to try; the tool shows the resolution the camera actually delivers.
webcam-test.faq.a3: It shows the image like a mirror; people on the call still see it unflipped.
webcam-test.faq.a4: No, unless you click Take photo to download one.
webcam-test.faq.a5: Yes, turn on the microphone with the camera to see the sound level.

screen-recorder.ph: Not recording. Press Start recording and choose a screen, window or tab.
screen-recorder.sysAudio: Record system / tab audio (choose "Share audio" when the browser asks)
screen-recorder.mic: Record your voice from the microphone
screen-recorder.note: Screen recording works in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on desktop; phones don't support it yet. Videos are saved straight to your device, never uploaded. The format is MP4 when your browser supports it, otherwise WebM (opens in Chrome, VLC); to get MP4 you can convert it with the Video Compressor tool.
screen-recorder.noSupport: This browser doesn't support screen recording. Please use Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a computer.
screen-recorder.errStart: Couldn't start recording. Please try again.
screen-recorder.errMic: Couldn't use the microphone (blocked or missing). Recording continues without your voice.
screen-recorder.errEmpty: Nothing was recorded. Please try again.
screen-recorder.seo.how1: Record your screen, a window or a browser tab to make tutorials, report software bugs or save a presentation, with nothing to install.
screen-recorder.seo.how2: Choose to record computer or tab audio, your voice through the microphone, a 3-second countdown and the video quality. Pause, resume, stop and save the file.
screen-recorder.seo.how3: The video is recorded on your device, never uploaded and has no watermark.
screen-recorder.faq.a1: Yes, choose Share audio when the browser asks; depending on the system only tab audio may be available.
screen-recorder.faq.q2: Can I record on a phone?
screen-recorder.faq.a2: Most mobile browsers do not support screen recording yet.
screen-recorder.faq.a3: Usually WebM or MP4 depending on the browser.
screen-recorder.faq.a4: No fixed limit; long recordings use a lot of memory.

guitar-tuner.idle: Turn on the microphone, then pluck a string
guitar-tuner.strings: Strings (tap to hear the reference tone)
guitar-tuner.tips: Tip: pluck one string at a time, let it ring naturally and keep the instrument close to the microphone. If the needle leans left the string is flat (tighten it); if it leans right the string is sharp (loosen it). Within ±5 cents is in tune.
guitar-tuner.errDenied: The microphone is blocked. Click the lock icon next to the page address, allow Microphone, then try again.
guitar-tuner.errMic: Couldn't open the microphone. Check that it's plugged in and not used by another app.
guitar-tuner.seo.howTitle: Tune your guitar with the microphone
guitar-tuner.seo.how1: Pluck a string and the tool listens through the microphone, detects the pitch and tells you whether the string is flat or sharp so you can turn the peg until it is in tune.
guitar-tuner.seo.how2: Supports guitar, ukulele, 4-string bass and violin; choose standard tuning or half a step down and adjust the A4 reference pitch. Click a string to hear the reference note.
guitar-tuner.seo.how3: Audio is processed only on your device and never recorded.
guitar-tuner.faq.q1: What are the standard guitar notes?
guitar-tuner.faq.a1: From string 6 to string 1: E A D G B E.
guitar-tuner.faq.a2: It is the reference pitch of the note A; some bands use 432 or 442 Hz.
guitar-tuner.faq.q3: Why does the needle jump around?
guitar-tuner.faq.a3: Noise or several strings ringing; pluck one string at a time in a quiet place with the guitar near the microphone.
guitar-tuner.faq.q4: Does it work on a phone?
guitar-tuner.faq.a4: Yes, allow the microphone when the browser asks.
guitar-tuner.faq.q5: What is half a step down?
guitar-tuner.faq.a5: Every string tuned a semitone lower (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb), common in rock.

password-gen.noAmb: Avoid look-alike characters (O 0 o I l 1)
password-gen.num: Add a number at the end
password-gen.ppNote: Random passphrases are easy to remember yet hard to guess, ideal as the master password of a password manager or your computer.
password-gen.privacy: Passwords are generated and checked on your device with your browser's secure random generator; nothing is sent anywhere or saved.
password-gen.pickSet: Choose at least one character type
password-gen.tipRepeat: Avoid repeating one character many times.
password-gen.tipYear: Avoid birth years or other guessable years.
password-gen.tipReuse: Never reuse a password across sites; a password manager helps.
password-gen.seo.how1: Short or guessable passwords are the top reason accounts get hijacked. A strong password should be 12 characters or longer with upper and lower case letters, numbers and symbols.
password-gen.seo.how2: Choose the length and character types, or create an easy-to-remember passphrase of several random words. The tool rates the strength and estimates how long it would take to crack.
password-gen.seo.how3: Passwords are generated with the browser's secure random number generator and are not sent anywhere.
password-gen.faq.q1: How many characters make a strong password?
password-gen.faq.a1: 12 or more with all character types; a passphrase of 4 to 5 random words is also very strong.
password-gen.faq.q2: Should I reuse one password for many accounts?
password-gen.faq.a2: No. Every account should have its own password; use a password manager to remember them.
password-gen.faq.a3: No. They only appear on your screen.
password-gen.faq.a4: A few random words joined together, easier to remember but still hard to guess.
password-gen.faq.q5: Should I turn on two-factor authentication?
password-gen.faq.a5: Yes. It protects your account even if your password leaks.

signature.drawTip: Sign with your mouse, stylus or finger inside the box. On a phone, turn it sideways for more room.
signature.name: Full name
signature.fontNote: Some handwriting fonts don't fully support accented letters; if accents look off, choose Dancing Script, Great Vibes, Allura, Pacifico or Caveat.
signature.legal: Your signature is created on your device and never sent anywhere. A signature image in a document doesn't replace a legally valid digital signature where one is required.
signature.empty: You haven't signed yet. Please sign in the box first.
signature.seo.how1: Draw your signature with a mouse, stylus or finger, or type your name to create a handwritten-style signature with adjustable slant, ink color and stroke thickness.
signature.seo.how2: Download a transparent PNG to insert into Word, PDF or email, an SVG that scales without blurring, or a JPG on white.
signature.seo.how3: Your signature is created on your device and never sent anywhere.
signature.faq.q1: How do I add the signature to Word?
signature.faq.a1: Download the transparent PNG and insert it as a picture.
signature.faq.q2: Can I sign a PDF directly?
signature.faq.a3: Some handwriting fonts do not support every accent; choose another style.
signature.faq.q4: Is an image signature legally valid?
signature.faq.a4: It depends on the agreement; transactions requiring digital signatures need a certificate.

logo-maker.svgNote: The SVG file loads Google Fonts online; when placing it in design software install the same font, or use the large PNG. The logo you make is yours, but check it doesn't match a registered trademark before using it for business.
logo-maker.name: Brand name
logo-maker.seo.how1: Quickly create a logo for a cafe, online shop or YouTube channel: enter the brand name and slogan, choose an icon, layout, font and colors.
logo-maker.seo.how2: Layouts include icon on the left, icon on top, round badge or text only, with ready color suggestions. Download PNG, large PNG or SVG, with an optional transparent background.
logo-maker.seo.how3: The logo is made in your browser. Before commercial use, check that the name and design do not match a registered trademark.
logo-maker.faq.q1: Can I use the logo commercially?
logo-maker.faq.a1: Yes, but check for trademark conflicts yourself before registering it.
logo-maker.faq.q2: Which format is best for printing?
logo-maker.faq.a2: SVG or the large PNG (×4) for sharp prints.
logo-maker.faq.q3: Why does the SVG show the wrong font?
logo-maker.faq.a3: The SVG loads Google Fonts online; use the PNG when working offline.
logo-maker.faq.a4: Yes, turn on the transparent background option when downloading.
logo-maker.faq.a5: The current design is kept in your browser when you come back.

notepad.welcomeBody:
Type your notes here. Every change is saved automatically in this browser.

Tip: press "New note" to add more, use the search box to filter, and download as .txt when you need it on another device.
notepad.open: Open a .txt file or drop it here
notepad.privacy: Notes are stored only in this browser on this device (not synced elsewhere). Clearing browsing data will erase them, so download any important notes.
notepad.full: Browser storage is full. Download and delete some old notes.
notepad.confirmDel: Delete this note? This can't be undone.
notepad.tooBig: File is larger than 2 MB and can't be opened in the notepad.
notepad.seo.how1: Take quick notes in the browser; every change is saved automatically, so nothing is lost if you close the tab. Create many notes, pin important ones and search them.
notepad.seo.how2: Open a .txt file or drag it in, change the font size, use a monospace font, count words and characters, and download one note or all of them.
notepad.seo.how3: Notes are stored only in the browser on this device and are not synced online.
notepad.faq.q2: Can I open my notes on another device?
notepad.faq.a2: They do not sync; download them or use Web Desktop with Google Drive.
notepad.faq.q3: Will clearing browser data delete my notes?
notepad.faq.a3: It may; download all notes as a backup.
notepad.faq.a4: It depends on browser storage, usually a few MB; the tool warns you when it is full.

image-resize.dropTitle: Choose images or drag them here
image-resize.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG. Many images at once, each under 40 MB.
image-resize.keep: Keep aspect ratio (leave one box empty to calculate it)
image-resize.seo.how1: Phone photos are usually very large and heavy to send or upload. The tool shrinks or enlarges by pixels, by percentage, or to preset sizes for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and ID photos.
image-resize.seo.how2: Keep the aspect ratio so images do not stretch; when the ratio differs, choose padding, cropping or stretching. Process many images at once.
image-resize.seo.how3: Images are processed on your device and never uploaded.
image-resize.faq.a1: Shrinking does not; enlarging a lot does. Use AI Image Upscaling if you need to enlarge.
image-resize.faq.q2: What size is best for Facebook?
image-resize.faq.a2: Shared images are about 1200×630 px; this size is built in.
image-resize.faq.q3: Can I resize many images at once?
image-resize.faq.q4: How many pixels is a 4×6 cm photo?
image-resize.faq.a4: 472×709 px at 300 dpi; choose the built-in 4×6 ID photo size.
image-resize.faq.a5: No. Everything runs in your browser.

image-crop.dropTitle: Choose an image or drag it here
image-crop.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG; under 40 MB. You can also paste with Ctrl+V.
image-crop.tip: Drag the frame to move it, drag the squares on the corners/edges to resize. Arrow keys nudge 1 px (Shift: 10 px). Circle crops are saved as PNG with a transparent background.
image-crop.notImage: This file is not an image.
image-crop.tooBig: The image is larger than 40 MB.
image-crop.seo.how1: Cut away unwanted parts, center the subject or crop to exact ratios such as 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 or a circle for profile pictures.
image-crop.seo.how2: Drag the frame to move it and drag the corners to resize; rotate by 90° and flip horizontally or vertically. Choose the output format and width.
image-crop.seo.how3: You can also paste an image with Ctrl+V. Images are processed on your device.
image-crop.faq.q1: Does a circular crop have a transparent background?
image-crop.faq.a1: Yes, when saved as PNG or WebP.
image-crop.faq.q2: Can I enter exact pixel sizes?
image-crop.faq.a2: Yes, enter the width and height of the crop box.
image-crop.faq.a3: No, the remaining part keeps its full sharpness.
image-crop.faq.q4: What is the maximum file size?
image-crop.faq.q5: Can I nudge the frame with the keyboard?
image-crop.faq.a5: Yes, the arrow keys move the frame step by step.

image-to-pdf.dropTitle: Choose images or drag them here
image-to-pdf.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP. Up to 200 images, each under 40 MB.
image-to-pdf.dragTip: Drag images to reorder pages, or use the ◀ ▶ buttons. Images are processed on your device.
image-to-pdf.err: Couldn't create the PDF. Please try again.
image-to-pdf.seo.how1: Turn photos of documents, receipts or homework into one PDF to email or submit online.
image-to-pdf.seo.how2: Drag and drop to set the page order, choose A4 or the image size, orientation, margins and fit. Up to 200 images per file.
image-to-pdf.seo.how3: Images are processed on your device and never uploaded.
image-to-pdf.faq.a1: Yes, drag images or use the buttons, sort by name or reverse.
image-to-pdf.faq.a2: Lower the image quality in the PDF or use the Compress PDF tool.
image-to-pdf.faq.q3: Does it accept iPhone HEIC photos?
image-to-pdf.faq.a3: Convert HEIC to JPG first with the HEIC to JPG tool.
image-to-pdf.faq.a5: No. Everything runs in your browser.

pdf-to-image.dropTitle: Choose a PDF file or drag it here
pdf-to-image.dropHint: Up to 200 MB. The file is processed on your device.
pdf-to-image.tooBig: The file is larger than 200 MB.
pdf-to-image.err: Couldn't convert this page. Try a lower resolution.
pdf-to-image.seo.how1: Turn each PDF page into a JPG, PNG or WebP image to post on social media, insert into a presentation or view on a phone.
pdf-to-image.seo.how2: Choose the format, resolution (screen, standard, print) and the pages to convert, such as 1-3, 5. Download each image or all as a ZIP.
pdf-to-image.seo.how3: Files are processed on your device, up to 200 MB.
pdf-to-image.faq.a1: Low for screen viewing; the highest for printing.
pdf-to-image.faq.q2: Can I convert only some pages?
pdf-to-image.faq.a2: Yes, enter a range such as 1-3, 5.
pdf-to-image.faq.a3: PNG is sharper for text and drawings; JPG is lighter for photos.
pdf-to-image.faq.a4: PDFs with an open password are not supported yet.
pdf-to-image.faq.a5: No, they are processed on your device.

pdf-compress.dropTitle: Choose a PDF file or drag it here
pdf-compress.dropHint: Up to 200 MB. The file never leaves your device.
pdf-compress.lLightD: images stay nearly original, small reduction
pdf-compress.lMediumD: images stay clear, big reduction; text untouched
pdf-compress.lExtremeD: turns every page into an image; smallest, but text can't be selected or copied
pdf-compress.note: Mostly-text PDFs (exported from Word) are usually small already and shrink little; PDFs with many photos or scans shrink the most. If the result isn't smaller, try Strong or Maximum.
pdf-compress.tooBig: The file is larger than 200 MB.
pdf-compress.noImgs: No JPEG images to compress; the file structure was optimized.
pdf-compress.notSmaller: The compressed file isn't smaller than the original. Choose a stronger level, or this file is already optimized.
pdf-compress.seo.howTitle: Compress PDF to reduce file size
pdf-compress.seo.how1: A PDF is heavy because it contains high-resolution images. The tool re-compresses the JPEG images inside and optimizes the structure while keeping text sharp and selectable.
pdf-compress.seo.how2: There are four levels: light, recommended, strong and maximum (turns each page into an image; smallest, but text can no longer be selected).
pdf-compress.seo.how3: Files never leave your device, up to 200 MB.
pdf-compress.faq.q1: Why did my file shrink only a little?
pdf-compress.faq.a1: Text-only PDFs (exported from Word) are already small; compression works best on PDFs with many images or scans.
pdf-compress.faq.a2: At normal levels text is unchanged; only the maximum level turns pages into images.
pdf-compress.faq.a3: The recommended level balances size and clarity.
pdf-compress.faq.a4: Try the strong level; if still too large, use maximum.
pdf-compress.faq.a5: No. It is compressed in your browser.

pdf-to-word.dropTitle: Choose a PDF file or drag it here
pdf-to-word.dropHint: Up to 100 MB, 300 pages. The file is processed on your device.
pdf-to-word.mTextD: paragraphs and headings you can edit; complex layouts (tables, columns) may shift
pdf-to-word.mImageD: each page becomes an image in Word, identical to the original but not editable
pdf-to-word.mBothD: page images plus the text below them for copying
pdf-to-word.scanNote: Scanned PDFs (photos of pages) contain no real text; use the Image to Text (OCR) tool on each page, or choose "Keep page layout".
pdf-to-word.tooBig: The file is larger than 100 MB.
pdf-to-word.noText: No text found in this file (it may be a scan). Choose "Keep page layout" or use the OCR tool.
pdf-to-word.limited: only the first 300 pages were converted
pdf-to-word.seo.how1: Convert a PDF to a Word .docx file to edit the content. Editable text mode keeps paragraphs and headings; keep page layout mode gives an exact copy of the original but the text is not editable.
pdf-to-word.seo.how2: Both mode places the page image with the text underneath to copy. You can preview the text before downloading.
pdf-to-word.seo.how3: Files are processed on your device, up to 100 MB and 300 pages. For scanned PDFs, use the image-to-text (OCR) tool.
pdf-to-word.faq.a1: Paragraphs and headings are kept well; tables and multi-column layouts may shift.
pdf-to-word.faq.a2: They contain no real text; use the OCR tool or keep page layout mode.
pdf-to-word.faq.a3: The tool repairs accented letters that many PDFs draw as overlapping characters.
pdf-to-word.faq.a5: No, they are processed on your device.

word-to-pdf.dropTitle: Choose a Word file (.docx) or drag it here
word-to-pdf.dropHint: Up to 50 MB. The file is read on your device, never uploaded.
word-to-pdf.note: "Download PDF" creates the PDF right away (each page is a high-quality image). "Print / Save sharp-text PDF" opens the print dialog: choose the "Save as PDF" printer to get a PDF with selectable, searchable text. Complex layouts (headers, footers, text boxes, charts) may differ from the original.
word-to-pdf.oldDoc: Old .doc files (Word 97-2003) aren't supported yet. Open it in Word, save as .docx, then try again.
word-to-pdf.tooBig: The file is larger than 50 MB.
word-to-pdf.err: Couldn't create the PDF. Try the Print / Save PDF button.
word-to-pdf.printTip: Choose the "Save as PDF" printer to save the file.
word-to-pdf.seo.how1: Convert a Word .docx file to PDF so it looks the same on the recipient's device, with no shifted fonts or layout.
word-to-pdf.seo.how2: Download PDF creates the PDF instantly with each page as a high-quality image. Print / Save PDF uses the browser's print dialog for sharp, selectable text.
word-to-pdf.seo.how3: The file is read on your device, never uploaded, up to 50 MB.
word-to-pdf.faq.a1: Not yet. Open it in Word and save it as .docx.
word-to-pdf.faq.q2: How do I get sharp text?
word-to-pdf.faq.a2: Use Print / Save PDF and choose the Save as PDF printer.
word-to-pdf.faq.q3: Is the layout the same as in Word?
word-to-pdf.faq.a3: Very close for ordinary documents; complex layouts may differ slightly.
word-to-pdf.faq.a5: No, they are processed on your device.

pdf-sign.dropTitle: Choose the PDF to sign or drag it here
pdf-sign.dropHint: Up to 100 MB. The file is never uploaded.
pdf-sign.tip: Pick a signature, then click on the page to place it. Drag to move, drag the square at the bottom corner to resize, press × or Delete to remove. This image signature suits everyday paperwork; it doesn't replace a digital signature where one is legally required.
pdf-sign.upHint: Photo of your signature on white paper (JPG, PNG)
pdf-sign.clickPage: Click on the page to place it
pdf-sign.emptySig: No signature yet. Draw it, type your name or upload an image.
pdf-sign.tooBig: The file is larger than 100 MB.
pdf-sign.nothing: You haven't placed a signature on the page yet.
pdf-sign.seo.how1: Sign contracts, forms and reports in PDF without printing and scanning. Create a signature by drawing, typing your name or uploading a photo of your signature on white paper.
pdf-sign.seo.how2: Choose a signature and click the page to place it, drag to move and resize; add dates and text. Signatures are saved for next time.
pdf-sign.seo.how3: Files are never uploaded. An image signature is not a certificate-based digital signature.
pdf-sign.faq.a1: It is an image signature; its validity depends on what the parties agree. Transactions that require a digital signature need a licensed certificate.
pdf-sign.faq.q2: Can I use a photo of my paper signature?
pdf-sign.faq.a2: Yes, the tool removes the white background so the signature is transparent.
pdf-sign.faq.a3: Yes, place signatures on any page.
pdf-sign.faq.q4: Is my file sent to a server?
pdf-sign.faq.a4: No. Everything runs in your browser.

pdf-edit.dropTitle: Choose a PDF file or drag it here
pdf-edit.dropHint: Up to 100 MB. The file is never uploaded.
pdf-edit.flatten: Lock the form after filling (can't be edited again)
pdf-edit.tip: Choose a tool, then click on the page to place it. Click text to edit it, drag to move, drag the square at the bottom corner to resize, press Delete to remove. Note: "Black box/White-out" only covers content visually; the original text underneath stays in the file. To truly remove sensitive information, also run Compress PDF at the Maximum level (turns pages into images).
pdf-edit.clickPage: Click on the page to place it
pdf-edit.clickImg: Click on the page to place the image
pdf-edit.tooBig: The file is larger than 100 MB.
pdf-edit.unicodeLocked: Fields with accented or non-Latin text were written directly onto the page (those fields can no longer be edited).
pdf-edit.seo.howTitle: Edit PDFs and fill in forms
pdf-edit.seo.how1: Add text, check marks, crosses and images to PDF pages, or cover areas with white or black boxes to hide information, without paid software.
pdf-edit.seo.how2: If the file has form fields, the tool lists them so you can fill them in and optionally lock them afterwards. Choose the font, size and color of the text you add.
pdf-edit.seo.how3: Files are never uploaded, up to 100 MB.
pdf-edit.faq.q1: Can I edit existing text in the PDF?
pdf-edit.faq.a1: Not directly; cover the old text with a white box and add new text on top.
pdf-edit.faq.q2: Does a black box really remove information?
pdf-edit.faq.a2: The box sits on top; the original text underneath may still be in the file. For truly confidential data, convert the PDF to images after covering.
pdf-edit.faq.q3: Can I fill in text with accents?
pdf-edit.faq.a3: Yes; fields with characters the standard fonts lack are written directly onto the page.
pdf-edit.faq.q4: What does locking the form do?
pdf-edit.faq.a4: It turns the filled-in content into part of the page so others can no longer change it.
pdf-edit.faq.a5: No, it is processed on your device.

image-ocr.dropTitle: Choose images or a scanned PDF, or drag them here
image-ocr.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, PDF. You can also paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V.
image-ocr.enhance: Sharpen the image before reading (blurry images, small text)
image-ocr.outPh: The text from your image will appear here.
image-ocr.note: Recognition runs in your browser; the first time it downloads the engine and language data (about 5–20 MB per language), later runs are faster. Sharp images with printed text on a light background work best; handwriting is hard to recognize.
image-ocr.max3: Choose at most 3 languages for fast, accurate recognition.
image-ocr.pdfLimit: Only the first 50 pages of the PDF were added.
image-ocr.noText: No text found. Try a sharper image, the right language, or turn on sharpening.
image-ocr.errNet: Couldn't download the recognition engine or language data. Check your internet connection and try again.
image-ocr.seo.how1: OCR recognizes text in photos, screenshots or scanned PDFs and turns it into editable text, saving you from retyping.
image-ocr.seo.how2: Choose up to 3 languages in the image, turn on sharpening for blurry photos or small text, then click Extract text. Copy the result or download a .txt file.
image-ocr.seo.how3: Recognition runs in your browser; the first time it needs to download the recognizer and language data.
image-ocr.faq.a1: Yes, choose the right language; sharp images give the best results.
image-ocr.faq.q2: Can it read multi-page scanned PDFs?
image-ocr.faq.a2: Yes, up to the first 50 pages.
image-ocr.faq.a3: Blurry or tilted photos and handwriting are hard to read; shoot straight, with good light, and turn on sharpening.
image-ocr.faq.a4: No. Recognition runs on your device.
image-ocr.faq.a5: Poorly. It works best with printed text.

heic-jpg.dropTitle: Choose HEIC photos or drag them here
heic-jpg.dropHint: .heic / .heif photos from iPhone or iPad. Many at once, each under 50 MB.
heic-jpg.note: Photos are converted on your device. The first time, the HEIC decoder (about 1.5 MB) is downloaded. For Live Photos only the main frame is kept. GPS location data from the original isn't carried over.
heic-jpg.notHeic: not a HEIC photo. For regular JPG/PNG images use the Convert Image Format tool.
heic-jpg.errNet: Couldn't download the decoder. Check your connection and try again.
heic-jpg.errDecode: Couldn't read this photo (damaged file or unsupported HEIC variant).
heic-jpg.seo.howTitle: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG
heic-jpg.seo.how1: iPhones save photos as HEIC to save space, but many Windows computers, websites and programs cannot open them. Converting to JPG or PNG makes them open everywhere.
heic-jpg.seo.how2: Select many photos at once, choose the format and quality, then download each photo or all of them as a ZIP.
heic-jpg.seo.how3: Photos are converted on your device; the first time it downloads the HEIC decoder.
heic-jpg.faq.a1: The high-efficiency image format Apple uses by default, about half the size of JPG.
heic-jpg.faq.q2: Does converting to JPG lose quality?
heic-jpg.faq.a2: At high quality the difference is practically invisible.
heic-jpg.faq.q3: How do I make my iPhone shoot JPG?
heic-jpg.faq.a3: Go to Settings > Camera > Formats and choose Most Compatible.
heic-jpg.faq.a4: Each photo must be under 50 MB.
heic-jpg.faq.a5: No, they are converted on your device.

image-upscale.dropTitle: Choose an image or drag it here
image-upscale.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Small, blurry or old photos benefit the most.
image-upscale.mX4p: reduces noise, for phone pictures and old photos
image-upscale.mX4c: removes JPEG artifacts, for images saved from the web
image-upscale.note: The AI runs on your device; images are never sent anywhere. The first time it downloads a 5–20 MB model. Images are processed in small tiles, so large images may take a few minutes; a recent Chrome or Edge is recommended (much faster with WebGPU).
image-upscale.tooBig: The image is larger than 40 MB.
image-upscale.loadingModel: Downloading the AI model (first time only)…
image-upscale.shrunk: The image is large, so it was reduced to
image-upscale.err: Couldn't run the AI in this browser. Try a recent Chrome or Edge.
image-upscale.seo.howTitle: Sharpen and enlarge images with AI
image-upscale.seo.how1: AI super-resolution enlarges small, blurry or old images 2 or 4 times and restores detail, far better than ordinary resizing.
image-upscale.seo.how2: Choose a mode: 2× keeps detail; 4× for photos reduces noise; 4× for compressed images removes JPEG artifacts. Choose the output format and download.
image-upscale.seo.how3: The AI runs on your device and images are not sent anywhere; the first time it downloads the model, and slower devices take longer.
image-upscale.faq.q1: Does AI invent detail that is not real?
image-upscale.faq.a1: The AI predicts plausible detail, so tiny parts may differ from reality.
image-upscale.faq.q2: Why does it take so long?
image-upscale.faq.a2: The model runs on your device; large images and slow devices need more time.
image-upscale.faq.a3: Very large images are reduced first to avoid running out of memory.
image-upscale.faq.q4: Are images uploaded to a server?
image-upscale.faq.a4: No. Processing happens entirely in the browser.
image-upscale.faq.a5: Yes with small images; computers are faster.

video-compress.dropTitle: Choose a video or drag it here
video-compress.dropHint: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI. Best under 300 MB (max 500 MB).
video-compress.note: The video is compressed in your browser with ffmpeg and never uploaded. The first time, the processor (about 31 MB) is downloaded. Compression runs on the CPU, so it's slower than desktop software: a 1-minute video usually takes 1–5 minutes. Keep this tab open until it finishes.
video-compress.tooBig: The video is larger than 500 MB, which is more than the browser can handle. Trim it first.
video-compress.errCode: ffmpeg couldn't process this video (unusual format or damaged file).
video-compress.notSmaller: The compressed video isn't smaller (the original is already well compressed). Choose Strong or a lower resolution.
video-compress.seo.howTitle: Compress videos to reduce file size
video-compress.seo.how1: Phone videos are very large and hard to send by messaging apps or email or to upload. The tool re-compresses them with ffmpeg right in the browser.
video-compress.seo.how2: Choose light, medium or strong compression, lower the maximum resolution and drop the audio if you do not need it. Accepts MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV and AVI.
video-compress.seo.how3: Videos are never uploaded; the first time it downloads the video engine, and large videos need a device with plenty of memory.
video-compress.faq.a1: Slightly; the medium level keeps good quality at a much smaller size.
video-compress.faq.q2: What is the maximum video size?
video-compress.faq.a2: Ideally under 300 MB, at most 500 MB.
video-compress.faq.q3: Why does it take so long?
video-compress.faq.a3: Video encoding is demanding; long, high-resolution videos can take several minutes.
video-compress.faq.a4: No. It is processed on your device.
video-compress.faq.a5: Yes, for example going from 4K to 1080p cuts the size a lot.

video-to-mp3.dropTitle: Choose a video or drag it here
video-to-mp3.dropHint: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, FLV… Up to 1 GB.
video-to-mp3.fade: Fade in and out (2 seconds), nice for ringtones
video-to-mp3.note: Processed in your browser with ffmpeg; the video is never uploaded. The first time, the processor (about 31 MB) is downloaded. Only extract audio from videos you have the right to use.
video-to-mp3.tooBig: The file is larger than 1 GB, more than the browser can handle.
video-to-mp3.badTime: Invalid time. Use minutes:seconds, e.g. 1:30; the end must be after the start.
video-to-mp3.noAudio: Couldn't extract audio. The video may have no sound or use an unsupported format.
video-to-mp3.seo.howTitle: Extract audio from video to MP3
video-to-mp3.seo.how1: Take the music, a lecture or any sound in a video and save it as MP3 or another format to listen to or use as a ringtone.
video-to-mp3.seo.how2: Choose the format, quality, start and end time (taken straight from the playing video) and an optional fade in and out.
video-to-mp3.seo.how3: It runs in your browser with ffmpeg and the video is never uploaded; up to 1 GB.
video-to-mp3.faq.a1: 192 kbps is recommended for music; the voice level is lighter for lectures.
video-to-mp3.faq.q2: Can I cut just one part?
video-to-mp3.faq.a2: Yes, enter the start and end time as minutes:seconds.
video-to-mp3.faq.q3: How do I make an iPhone ringtone?
video-to-mp3.faq.a3: Cut a clip under 30 seconds, turn on fading and choose M4A.
video-to-mp3.faq.q4: Can it extract audio from YouTube?
video-to-mp3.faq.a4: The tool only processes video files on your device.

excel-word-fill.word.label: 1. Word file (.docx)
excel-word-fill.word.drop: Choose a Word file or drag it here
excel-word-fill.xl.label: 2. Excel file (.xlsx)
excel-word-fill.xl.hint: 4-column layout: [No. | Marker | Description | Content to insert], row 1 is the header. Lines in the content that start with "1.", "2."... or "I.", "II."... are shown in red.
excel-word-fill.xl.drop: Choose an Excel file or drag it here
excel-word-fill.how.title: How to use
excel-word-fill.how.1: In the Word file, type the markers to fill, for example <<<name>>>, <<<date>>>.
excel-word-fill.how.2: In the Excel file, column B holds the marker name (name, date...) and column D holds the text to insert.
excel-word-fill.how.3: Multi-line content keeps its line breaks; lines starting with "1.", "2." or "I.", "II." are shown in red.
excel-word-fill.how.4: Markers that are in the Word file but not in the Excel file are left empty and reported to you.
excel-word-fill.err.noSheet: The Excel file has no sheet with data.
excel-word-fill.err.need: Please choose both a Word file and an Excel file.
excel-word-fill.err.big: The file is larger than 40 MB.
excel-word-fill.done: Done. The finished Word file has been downloaded.
excel-word-fill.missing: Note: these markers are in the Word file but not in the Excel file, so they were left empty:
excel-word-fill.seo.howTitle: Fill a Word template with Excel data
excel-word-fill.seo.how1: Write a Word template with markers such as <<<name>>> and <<<date>>>, then fill them with content from an Excel file while keeping the template's formatting. Ideal for reports and recurring documents.
excel-word-fill.seo.how2: The Excel file has 4 columns: number, marker name, description and content. Multi-line content keeps its line breaks; heading lines such as 1., 2., I., II. are colored red automatically.
excel-word-fill.seo.how3: Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
excel-word-fill.faq.q1: How do I write a marker in Word?
excel-word-fill.faq.a1: Three less-than signs, the name, three greater-than signs, for example <<<name>>>.
excel-word-fill.faq.q2: What if a marker is missing from Excel?
excel-word-fill.faq.a2: It is left empty and listed in a message so you can check it.
excel-word-fill.faq.q3: Is the template's text formatting kept?
excel-word-fill.faq.a3: Yes, content takes the formatting at the marker position.
excel-word-fill.faq.q4: Can I use an old .doc file?

excel-cell-merge.intro: Merge the content of cell A1 from all sheets (or from the first sheet of several files) into one shared cell A1; the same for A2, A3... B1, B2... When several sources have data in the same cell, they are joined, one source per line.
excel-cell-merge.type.label: 1. Merge type
excel-cell-merge.type.sheets: Merge the sheets of one file
excel-cell-merge.pick.one: 2. Choose 1 Excel file (a file with several sheets)
excel-cell-merge.pick.oneHint: Sheets are merged in tab order.
excel-cell-merge.drop: Choose a file or drag it here
excel-cell-merge.pick.many: 2. Choose the Excel files (the first sheet of each file is used)
excel-cell-merge.pick.manyHint: Merge order: by file name, A-Z.
excel-cell-merge.drop.many: Choose the files or drag them here
excel-cell-merge.header.label: Number of header rows
excel-cell-merge.header.hint: Header rows are taken from the first source only and not merged from later ones, to avoid repeated text.
excel-cell-merge.warn.none: No cell has data from 2 or more sources ({n} cells checked).
excel-cell-merge.warn.some: {n} cells have data from 2 or more sources. Their contents were joined with "." and a line break:
excel-cell-merge.err.noData: None of the sources has a cell with data.
excel-cell-merge.done: Done! {n} sources merged; {w} cells had data from 2 or more sources (joined).
excel-cell-merge.done.hdr: {h} header rows were taken from the first source only.
excel-cell-merge.seo.howTitle: Merge the same cells from many sheets or files
excel-cell-merge.seo.how1: When many people fill in the same Excel template, each in their own sheet or file, the tool merges the content of the same cell positions from all sources into one file.
excel-cell-merge.seo.how2: Choose to merge the sheets in one file or the first sheet of many files. Header rows are taken from the first source only. Cells with data from 2 or more sources are joined and listed for you to check.
excel-cell-merge.seo.how3: Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
excel-cell-merge.faq.q1: In what order are files merged?
excel-cell-merge.faq.a1: By file name A-Z; sheets follow the tab order.
excel-cell-merge.faq.a2: The values from each source are joined and the conflicting cells are listed.
excel-cell-merge.faq.q3: How is this different from Concatenate Excel Rows?
excel-cell-merge.faq.a3: Merging cells keeps the template layout; concatenating rows stacks tables one after another vertically.
excel-cell-merge.faq.a4: The tool takes the displayed value of each cell.

excel-row-concat.intro: Stack the data of several sheets (or the first sheet of several files) vertically into one long table, rows following each other.
excel-row-concat.type.label: 1. Choose the data source
excel-row-concat.pick.one: 2. Choose 1 Excel file (a file with several sheets)
excel-row-concat.pick.oneHint: Join order: sheets from left to right in the file.
excel-row-concat.drop: Choose a file or drag it here
excel-row-concat.pick.many: 2. Choose the Excel files (the first sheet of each file is used)
excel-row-concat.pick.manyHint: Join order: by file name, A-Z. Only the first sheet of each file is used.
excel-row-concat.drop.many: Choose the files or drag them here
excel-row-concat.header.label: Number of header rows
excel-row-concat.header.hint: Header rows are kept once at the top of the result; later sources automatically drop this number of header rows.
excel-row-concat.filter.label: Row filters (apply to data rows only, not to header rows)
excel-row-concat.filter.emptyHint: Rows with no cell that contains data (a cell with only spaces also counts as empty).
excel-row-concat.filter.fempty: Remove rows whose formulas return empty
excel-row-concat.filter.femptyHint: Rows that contain only formula cells with empty results (e.g. =IF(A5="","",...)) and no cell with a real value.
excel-row-concat.err.none: No rows left after filtering, so no result file was created.
excel-row-concat.done: Done! {n} sources stacked vertically, {rows} rows in total.
excel-row-concat.done.hdr: Dropped {h} repeated header rows from the {k} later sources; kept only once at the top.
excel-row-concat.done.fempty: Removed {n} rows whose formulas return empty.
excel-row-concat.seo.howTitle: Stack rows from many sheets or Excel files
excel-row-concat.seo.how1: Stack the data of many sheets or Excel files with the same column structure into one table, for example combining lists from several branches.
excel-row-concat.seo.how2: Header rows are kept once at the top. There are options to remove empty rows and rows containing only formulas that return empty.
excel-row-concat.seo.how3: Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
excel-row-concat.faq.q1: Must the files have the same columns?
excel-row-concat.faq.a1: They should have the same column order so data lands in the right column.
excel-row-concat.faq.q2: Which sheet is used when combining files?
excel-row-concat.faq.a2: The first sheet of each file, in file-name order A-Z.
excel-row-concat.faq.a3: A row whose cells only contain formulas like =IF(A5="","",...) that return empty.
excel-row-concat.faq.a4: Yes, once at the top of the result file.

excel-formula-merge.h.firstlast: Takes the value of the first / last source that has data
excel-formula-merge.h.minmax: Finds the smallest / largest number across all sources
excel-formula-merge.h.unique: Lists the values, removing duplicates automatically
excel-formula-merge.h.sum: Adds up all the numbers found in cell A1 across the sources
excel-formula-merge.h.count: Counts how many sources have data in cell A1
excel-formula-merge.h.group: Groups identical values and counts each kind
excel-formula-merge.h.if: Tests a condition: true gives value 1, false gives value 2
excel-formula-merge.hx.if:
IF(>0, Pass, Fail, A1)
IF(B1="Male", Mr, Ms)
excel-formula-merge.h.sumif: Sums / counts the values that meet a given condition
excel-formula-merge.h.avgif: Averages the values that meet the condition
excel-formula-merge.h.anyall: Checks whether any / all sources meet the condition (returns TRUE/FALSE)
excel-formula-merge.h.concat: Joins texts with a separator (e.g. a dash)
excel-formula-merge.h.trim: Removes extra spaces at both ends / CONVERTS TO UPPERCASE
excel-formula-merge.h.replace: Finds an old word or phrase and replaces it with a new one
excel-formula-merge.h.year: Gets the year / month from the first source that has a date (Excel dates or dd/mm/yyyy text)
excel-formula-merge.h.range: Creates a date range from the smallest to the largest date
excel-formula-merge.h.missing: Reports "Missing" if there is no data / "Duplicate" if repeated data is found
excel-formula-merge.h.valid: Reports "Valid" or "TRUE" if the cell has data
excel-formula-merge.n.1: Joins text with a logical condition
excel-formula-merge.help.title: Supported formulas
excel-formula-merge.nest.title: Nested functions (up to 3 levels)
excel-formula-merge.type.label: 1. Choose the data source
excel-formula-merge.pick.one: 2. Choose 1 Excel file (a file with several sheets)
excel-formula-merge.drop: Choose a file or drag it here
excel-formula-merge.pick.many: 2. Choose the Excel files (the first sheet of each file is used)
excel-formula-merge.pick.manyHint: Source order (affects FIRST/LAST): by file name, A-Z.
excel-formula-merge.drop.many: Choose the files or drag them here
excel-formula-merge.topic.label: Topic name (type a name to show its saved formulas)
excel-formula-merge.scan: 3. Scan the files and show the formula table
excel-formula-merge.all.label: Apply a formula to all cells:
excel-formula-merge.topic.new: New topic "{name}". Enter formulas, then click "Save formulas".
excel-formula-merge.topic.found: Found formulas for "{name}". They will be applied after you scan the files.
excel-formula-merge.save.noName: Enter a topic name before saving.
excel-formula-merge.save.noTable: There is no formula table yet. Scan the files before saving.
excel-formula-merge.err.tooMany: The table has {n} cells, over the limit of {max}. Please split the data and try again.
excel-formula-merge.scan.applied: Applied the saved formulas of topic "{name}".
excel-formula-merge.dl.done: Done! The result file has been downloaded.
excel-formula-merge.seo.how1: Aggregate many sheets or Excel files with a formula for each cell: sum, count, average, max, min, joining text, removing duplicates, IF conditions, SUMIF, earliest and latest dates.
excel-formula-merge.seo.how2: Formulas can be nested and saved by topic for reuse next time. The formula engine is built in and does not use eval.
excel-formula-merge.seo.how3: Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
excel-formula-merge.faq.q1: What is an example formula to add sources?
excel-formula-merge.faq.a1: SUM(A1) adds the A1 values of all sources.
excel-formula-merge.faq.a2: Yes, for example CONCAT(A1, IF(B1="Male"," - Male"," - Female")).
excel-formula-merge.faq.q3: How do I check for missing data?
excel-formula-merge.faq.a3: Use the function that reports Missing when no source has data and Duplicate when values repeat.
excel-formula-merge.faq.q4: Can I save formulas for later?
excel-formula-merge.faq.a4: Yes, saved by topic in your browser.

web-desktop.pdfHint: Don't see anything? Click "Open in new tab" or "Download".
web-desktop.trashDriveNote: Items in the Trash still count toward your Drive storage until deleted forever.

web-desktop.gateBody: Sign in with Google so every file you create on the Desktop is saved in the WFTools/Desktop folder of your Google Drive and opens on any device. WFTools can only see files it created. Or try it right away and keep files in this browser only.
web-desktop.useLocal: Try it, save on this device
web-desktop.reconnectBody: Your Google session has expired. Click the button below to open your files again.
web-desktop.pasteInside: A folder can't be pasted inside itself. Choose a different folder.
web-desktop.seo.howTitle: A computer desktop in your browser
web-desktop.seo.how1: Web Desktop gives you a Windows-like workspace in the browser: draggable windows, a taskbar, a file manager, Notepad, an image viewer, a PDF viewer, a calculator and a calendar.
web-desktop.seo.how2: Sign in with Google to save files to the WFTools/Desktop folder in your Google Drive and open them on another computer. Without signing in, try it with storage in your browser.
web-desktop.seo.how3: It has a right-click menu, familiar shortcuts (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, F2, Del), a recycle bin and wallpaper settings.
web-desktop.faq.a1: In the WFTools/Desktop folder of your Google Drive when signed in, or in your browser in trial mode.
web-desktop.faq.a2: No. The tool can only access files it created itself in your Drive.
web-desktop.faq.q3: Can it open Word or Excel files?
web-desktop.faq.a3: You can store and download them; text files, images and PDFs open directly.
web-desktop.faq.q4: Does it work on a phone?
web-desktop.faq.a4: Yes, press and hold to open the right-click menu.
web-desktop.faq.q5: Can I restore a deleted file?
web-desktop.faq.a5: Yes, deleted files go to the Recycle Bin and can be restored.

Finalization deadline: 31 March for employers, 30 April for individuals filing themselves.

pit-tax.rulesNote4: đ per month; tax table with
pit-tax.seo.howTitle: How personal income tax on salary is calculated
pit-tax.seo.how1: Yearly personal income tax is charged on taxable income: total taxable salary and bonuses, minus mandatory insurance, the personal deduction, the dependant deduction and donations to charity, humanitarian and education causes.
pit-tax.seo.how2: From tax year 2026 the deduction is 15.5 million dong per month for yourself and 6.2 million dong per month for each dependant. The progressive table has 5 brackets: 5%, 10%, 20%, 30% and 35% (yearly limits are the monthly limits multiplied by 12).
pit-tax.seo.how3: A Tet bonus or 13th-month salary is added to your yearly income, so the last part of your income can move into a higher bracket. The tool shows how much extra tax the bonus alone causes.
pit-tax.faq.q1: How is personal income tax on salary calculated for 2026?
pit-tax.faq.a1: Take your total taxable income for the year, subtract mandatory insurance, the personal deduction of 15.5 million dong per month, the dependant deduction of 6.2 million dong per month and other allowed deductions, then apply the 5-bracket progressive table.
pit-tax.faq.q2: When do I pay more tax or get a refund?
pit-tax.faq.a2: If the tax for the whole year is higher than the tax withheld each month, you pay the difference; if it is lower, you get a refund or credit it to the next period. Enter the tax already withheld to see the difference.
pit-tax.faq.a3: Yes. A Tet bonus is salary income, so it is added to the taxable income of the year and taxed on the progressive table together with your salary.
pit-tax.faq.q4: When is the deadline to finalize personal income tax?
pit-tax.faq.a4: Employers finalize on your behalf by 31 March at the latest, and individuals who file themselves must do so with the tax office by 30 April of the following year.
pit-tax.faq.a5: The result is a reference based on the rules stated. It does not cover special cases such as income from several employers, foreigners or non-salary income, so check with the tax office when you finalize.

savings-bhxh.sv.foot: For reference only. Each month counts as 1/12 of a year; early withdrawal uses the actual days deposited divided by 365. Interest on bank deposits of individuals is currently exempt from personal income tax in Vietnam. The actual rate is set by each bank.
savings-bhxh.vnOnlyNote: The pension and social insurance parts follow Vietnam's Law on Social Insurance 2024 (amounts in Vietnamese dong, đ).
savings-bhxh.pn.avg: Average salary used for social insurance contributions (per month)

savings-bhxh.lp.foot: For reference only. Withdrawing social insurance in one lump sum gives up the contribution period used for a pension and for health insurance benefits later, so think it over carefully. The official amount is set by the social insurance agency.

savings-bhxh.sv.err.rate: The interest rate must be between 0 and 100 %/year.

savings-bhxh.sv.err.days: Days deposited must be between 1 and 1825.
savings-bhxh.sv.err.erate: The demand-deposit rate must be between 0 and 100 %/year.
savings-bhxh.sv.loss: Interest lost compared with a full term
savings-bhxh.sv.note.early: Early withdrawal only earns the demand-deposit rate for the actual days deposited.
savings-bhxh.sv.note.monthly: Interest is paid to your account every month and the principal is returned at maturity.
savings-bhxh.sv.note.roll: At the end of each term, principal and interest are combined and deposited again at the same rate.
savings-bhxh.sv.note.maturity: You receive the principal and all interest at maturity.
savings-bhxh.pn.err.years: Years of contributions must be between 0 and 60.
savings-bhxh.pn.err.months: Extra months must be between 0 and 11.

savings-bhxh.lp.under: Less than 1 year of contributions: you receive what was paid in, up to 2 months of average salary
savings-bhxh.seo.howTitle: How savings interest, pension and lump-sum social insurance are calculated
savings-bhxh.seo.how1: Interest on a fixed-term deposit equals the deposit times the yearly rate times the number of months divided by 12. You can take interest at maturity, take it every month, or roll principal and interest over so interest earns interest.
savings-bhxh.seo.how2: The monthly pension equals the pension rate times the average salary used for social insurance contributions. Under the Law on Social Insurance 2024, women with 15 years of contributions receive 45%; men with 15 years receive 40% and the rate rises with each extra year, up to a maximum of 75%.
savings-bhxh.seo.how3: The lump-sum payout is 1.5 months of average salary for each year contributed before 2014 and 2 months for each year contributed from 2014. Taking it gives up the contribution record you need for a pension and for health insurance later.
savings-bhxh.faq.q1: How much interest do I earn on 100 million dong for 12 months?
savings-bhxh.faq.a1: For a full 12 months the interest equals the deposit times the yearly rate. For example, at 6% a year the interest is 6 million dong. Enter your amount, term and the bank's rate for an exact result.
savings-bhxh.faq.q2: How is interest calculated if I withdraw early?
savings-bhxh.faq.a2: Most banks only pay the demand-deposit rate, usually very low, for the actual days deposited. The tool shows how much interest you lose compared with a full term.
savings-bhxh.faq.q3: How many years of contributions do I need for a pension?
savings-bhxh.faq.a3: Under the Law on Social Insurance 2024 you need at least 15 years of contributions and to reach retirement age. The maximum pension rate is 75% of the average salary used for contributions.
savings-bhxh.faq.q4: How is the lump-sum social insurance payout calculated?
savings-bhxh.faq.a4: Each year contributed before 2014 earns 1.5 months and each year from 2014 earns 2 months of average salary. Extra time of 1 to 6 months counts as half a year and 7 to 11 months as a full year.
savings-bhxh.faq.q5: Does the result replace the notice from the social insurance agency?
savings-bhxh.faq.a5: No. It is only an estimate based on the average salary you enter and does not include salary adjustment, early retirement or special cases. The official amount is set by the social insurance agency.

time-calc.dur.lines: One time span per line (hours:minutes:seconds). Add a minus sign to subtract.
time-calc.unix.dt: Or pick a date and time (your device time)
time-calc.work.errTime: Choose a start time and an end time.
time-calc.work.overnight: Overnight shift: the end time counts as the next day.
time-calc.lunar.none: This lunar date does not exist (check day 30 or the leap month).
time-calc.seo.howTitle: How time, work hours and calendar conversion are calculated
time-calc.seo.how1: The Add and subtract tab lets you enter several time spans as hours:minutes:seconds and add or subtract them, for example 1:30:00 + 0:45:30. The result is shown in hours, minutes and seconds, plus total minutes and decimal hours.
time-calc.seo.how2: The Work hours tab calculates the time between clock-in and clock-out, adds 24 hours when the shift passes midnight, subtracts the break and converts the result to decimal hours so you can multiply it by an hourly rate.
time-calc.seo.how3: A Unix timestamp is the number of seconds (or milliseconds) since 00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970. The lunar calendar is converted with an astronomical algorithm for the Vietnam time zone (UTC+7), including leap months and the Can Chi (sexagenary) names of the year and day.
time-calc.faq.q1: How do I add up several hour:minute:second durations?
time-calc.faq.a1: Enter each span as hours:minutes:seconds or as 1h 30m on its own line, put a minus sign in front of the ones to subtract, and the total updates right away together with decimal hours.
time-calc.faq.q2: How is an overnight shift calculated?
time-calc.faq.a2: If the end time is earlier than the start time, the tool assumes the shift ends the next day, adds 24 hours and then subtracts the break.
time-calc.faq.q3: What is a Unix timestamp and what forms does it come in?
time-calc.faq.a3: It is the number of seconds since 1 January 1970 UTC. It comes as 10 digits (seconds) or 13 digits (milliseconds); the tool recognizes which one you paste.
time-calc.faq.q4: Is the solar to lunar conversion accurate?
time-calc.faq.a4: The tool uses an astronomical algorithm for new moons and solar terms in the Vietnam time zone (UTC+7), matching the common perpetual calendars, including leap months.
time-calc.faq.q5: Can I convert from the lunar calendar back to the solar calendar?
time-calc.faq.a5: Yes. Enter the lunar day, month and year, tick leap month if needed, and the tool returns the matching solar date.

todo-pomodoro.td.empty: No tasks in this view yet.
todo-pomodoro.seo.howTitle: How to use the to-do list and Pomodoro timer
todo-pomodoro.seo.how1: Add a task, choose a priority and a due date if you want one. Urgent and overdue tasks are shown first, and you can filter by tasks that are not done, done, or due today.
todo-pomodoro.seo.how2: The Pomodoro technique splits your time into focused work sessions, 25 minutes by default, separated by 5-minute short breaks. After 4 sessions you take a 15-minute long break. You can change all of these durations.
todo-pomodoro.seo.how3: Pick the task you are working on, and every completed focus session is counted for it. Your data is saved in your own browser and is not sent anywhere.
todo-pomodoro.faq.a1: A time management method: work with full focus for 25 minutes, then rest for 5 minutes. After four sessions you take a longer break. The name comes from the tomato-shaped kitchen timer.
todo-pomodoro.faq.q2: Can I change the length of each session?
todo-pomodoro.faq.a2: Yes. You can set the minutes for focus, short break and long break and the number of sessions before a long break; the settings are remembered for next time.
todo-pomodoro.faq.q3: Does the timer keep running if I switch tabs?
todo-pomodoro.faq.a3: The page needs to stay open so it can ring. It counts time using the system clock, so it does not fall behind when you move to another tab.
todo-pomodoro.faq.q4: Where is my task list stored?
todo-pomodoro.faq.a4: In your browser storage on this device and never on a server. If you clear browser data or switch devices, the list will not be there.
todo-pomodoro.faq.q5: Is there a notification when time is up?
todo-pomodoro.faq.a5: A short chime plays, and the remaining time is shown in the tab title so you can follow it while working in another window.
